The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5b03d80e25997de7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (u, K) be a reduced absolute minimizer of (1.1) in a bounded Lipschitz domain Ω ⊂ R2, with g ∈ L∞(Ω). Every x ∈ K has an interior neighborhood in which K has one of the following forms, with C1,α arcs for some α > 0: (i) a single embedded arc with x in its interior; (ii) a single embedded arc ending at x; (iii) three embedded arcs meeting only at x, with pairwise angles 120 degrees. Moreover, for every open U ⋐ Ω, #{C ∈ π0(K) : C ∩ U ̸= ∅} < ∞, (1.4) where π0(K) denotes the set of global connected components of K.
